reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       ROUND(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS units_per_line
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives: SELECT country_code, ROUND(CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*), 2) AS units_per_line FROM sales GROUP BY country_code
SELECT country_code, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(units, 0)) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS units_per_line FROM sales GROUP BY 1
